high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One small, low-contrast dark mark is visible on the right lateral-dorsal margin midway between the blowhole and the peduncle.

other_distinctive_markers: Sharply defined, linear dorsal ridge along the posterior midline and a clearly visible, open blowhole at the anterior apex.
